title: Xylon
description:

body:
# ⚔️  XYLON ⚔️ 

## ⭐   The next best PvP server is right around the corner!


### ❓    What do we offer?

- ▶️  **1.9 FFA** - For those who love the Java PvP style!

- ▶️  **Duels** - For those who want to have a private 1v1 with other players!

- ▶️  **Wars** - For those who love fighting clans at in-game wars!

- ▶️  **Guilds** - For those who love teaming up with fellow players and going to war!


### How do I join? 
eu.xylon.gg **(eu)**, as.xylon.gg **(as)**, na.xylon.gg **(na)**, au.xylon.gg **(au)**

### Join the Discord to gain access to... 
- In-Game Rank Giveaways
- Game Nights
- Much More

Discord: https://discord.gg/bvV7Hz9W5P
Website: https://xylon.gg
Store: https://store.xylon.gg

**JOIN US TODAY!**
